name: Harukeki Kawa no Nagare ni Nosete
original_name: 遥けき川の流れにのせて
source:
Main character receives a prophecy that he can't return to his home town. But with his father's death on a snowy night he goes there and falls into the river on the way. He wakes up in care of twin sisters Rico and May.  Why do these girls live isolated in the mountains? Protagonist has to stay there until full recovery. He has enough time to reveal this mystery.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到無法回故鄉的預言。父親在雪夜去世後，他仍回到故鄉，卻在途中掉進河裡。醒來時，他正由雙胞胎姊妹莉子與真由照顧。為什麼這兩個女孩住在與世隔絕的山中？主角必須留在那裡，直到身體完全康復；他有足夠時間揭開這個謎團。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
